user_font_assets_filename_uidx.name: user_font_assets_filename_uidx
user_font_assets_filename_uidx.where: "assets"."kind" = 'font' and "assets"."original_filename" is not null and "assets"."deleted_at" is null and "assets"."status" in ('uploading', 'ready')

user_font_assets_content_hash_uidx.name: user_font_assets_content_hash_uidx
user_font_assets_content_hash_uidx.where: "assets"."kind" = 'font' and "assets"."content_hash" not like 'pending:%' and "assets"."deleted_at" is null and "assets"."status" = 'ready'

assets_preview_metadata_check.name: assets_preview_metadata_check
assets_preview_metadata_check.value:
("assets"."source_duration_ms" is null or "assets"."source_duration_ms" >= 0)
      and ("assets"."source_width" is null or "assets"."source_width" > 0)
      and ("assets"."source_height" is null or "assets"."source_height" > 0)
      and ("assets"."preview_version" is null or "assets"."preview_version" >= 1)
      and (("assets"."preview_status" in ('pending', 'ready') and "assets"."preview_key" is not null) or "assets"."preview_status" in ('failed', 'unsupported'))

projects_create_idempotency_uidx.name: projects_create_idempotency_uidx
projects_create_idempotency_uidx.where: "projects"."create_idempotency_key" is not null and "projects"."deleted_at" is null

projects_lifecycle_check.name: projects_lifecycle_check
projects_lifecycle_check.value: ("projects"."deleted_at" is null and "projects"."purge_after" is null) or ("projects"."deleted_at" is not null and "projects"."purge_after" is not null and "projects"."purge_after" >= "projects"."deleted_at")

render_jobs_lease_recovery_idx.name: render_jobs_lease_recovery_idx
render_jobs_lease_recovery_idx.where: "render_jobs"."lease_owner" is not null and "render_jobs"."status" not in ('done', 'failed', 'cancelled')
